description: A file's whole API in a few lines: every class, function and method with its line range and signature. Far cheaper than reading the file. Pass several in "paths" for all of them in one call.

path.description: The file, relative to the project, or its end like "cart.ts"

paths.description: Several files at once, instead of "path"

project.description: Optional project folder path when the MCP host does not pass workspace roots (defaults to server root)

name: map_file
title: File outline
